evidence.detail: The builder creates root interfaces 53500 and 53519, each containing the same 18 child option widgets 53501..53518.
Each option widget is created as selectable text with exact tooltip 'Select option', forced hover/action enablement and one-based placeholder labels derived from the option index.

The first root places the 18 options in a fixed six-row/three-column traversal while the second root lays the same option widgets in the alternate row/column traversal; both use 160-pixel horizontal and 17-pixel vertical spacing.

No exact-v308 class outside this builder references roots 53500/53519, and the builder contains no feature-specific title/resource literal. The semantic recovery therefore stops at the generic option-selection grid role.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the two-layout 18-option selection interface. No product/domain noun is inferred.
